story: [R00] Raid 1 — Encounter 3 begins.
[R02] Bob taunts the boss back.

      "Bob was counting, lost count, and rounded down."
[R03] Bob is meant to step out at 3 stacks, and does not.
[R03] Mini Boss turns on Dave.

[R03] Dave MISTAKE · Minor · Forgot to Taunt
      "Dave was mid-sentence about last week's wipe when the round came round again."

[R03] Greg MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Greg assumed the tank would take it back, and the tank assumed Greg had a plan."

[R03] Zed MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Zed has been waiting all fight to do the thing, and the boss has now noticed Zed doing the thing."
[R04] A raid-wide pulse hits everyone for 27.
[R04] Bob steps out at 4 stacks; Dave takes over.
[R04] Dave has lost Mini Boss's attention; it swings at Zed first.

[R04] Dave MISTAKE · Moderate · Forgot to Taunt (after g01:r3:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 1)
      "Dave is holding the line beautifully, several steps to the left of where the line is."

[R04] Cindy MISTAKE · Severe · Healed the Wrong Target (after g01:r4:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Cindy heals somebody who was at full health, who did not need it, and who says thank you."

[R05] Zed MISTAKE · Critical · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g10:r3:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)
      "Zed did the arithmetic, concluded the tank was underperforming, and generously stepped in."

[R06] Mini Boss turns on Zed.

[R06] Steve MISTAKE · Severe · AoE'd the Sleeping Add
      "Steve was told not to touch the sleeping one and has touched everything else at once."

[R06] Natsuna MISTAKE · Severe · Healed the Wrong Target (after g09:r5:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)

[R06] Natsuna MISTAKE · Moderate · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after g09:r5:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)

[R09] Greg MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Greg opened at full strength on round one, because opening at half strength has never once felt good."

[R13] Wanda is DOWNED.

[R19] Fern MISTAKE · Minor · Healed the Wrong Target (after g05:r17:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)

[R20] Bob MISTAKE · Moderate · Started an Argument in Raid Chat

[R21] Pip MISTAKE · Severe · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g06:r20:MIS_WRONG_TARGET, depth 1)
      "Nobody asked Pip to go first, and nobody has ever needed to."

[R21] Steve MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g08:r20:MIS_WRONG_TARGET, depth 2)

[R21] Zed MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g10:r20:MIS_AGGRO, depth 1)

[R21] Cindy MISTAKE · Severe · Went AFK (after g00:r21:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Cindy has decided this is a good round to sit out, and told nobody."
[R21] Cindy has wandered off for three rounds.
[R23] Dave taunts the boss back.

[R23] Pip MISTAKE · Minor · Attacked the Wrong Target (after g06:r20:MIS_WRONG_TARGET, depth 1)
      "Somebody called a switch, and Pip switched to the thing they had just switched off."

[R23] Steve MISTAKE · Moderate · Attacked the Wrong Target (after g08:r20:MIS_WRONG_TARGET, depth 2)
      "Steve is very confident about which one is the dangerous one, and very wrong."

[R23] Zed MISTAKE · Severe · Attacked the Wrong Target (after g10:r21:MIS_AGGRO, depth 2)
      "Zed had the long cast half done and was not about to throw that away."
[R23] Raid 1 — Encounter 3 is defeated.
why: Mid-tier, properly geared, average morale — the ordinary case.
